W2-05.note: orchestrator 2026-08-11: verifier found a REAL runtime defect the residue had not declared - macos/build-rustty-signed.sh signed with `--timestamp=none`, and this batch made that script the only codesigning step of both release workflows, so notarization would have been rejected ('signature does not include a secure timestamp') and stapler would then fail. Fixed by gating the flag on identity: ad-hoc keeps --timestamp=none (cannot be timestamped, must work offline), a real DEVELOPER_ID gets bare --timestamp (Apple's default TSA = the oracle's signature shape). Spelled explicitly rather than as an empty array because the script runs under `set -u` on macOS bash 3.2, where expanding an empty array aborts - verified both paths execute clean.
